subject: Decision Making
title: Superforecasting Teams
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Superforecasting Teams.

hook.text: Philip Tetlock found that some forecasters are consistently more accurate than intelligence analysts with classified.

buildup.text: He called them superforecasters. They update frequently, think in probabilities, and resist overconfidence.

discovery.text: When superforecasters work in teams, their accuracy improves further.

twist.text: The best teams had a specific culture: disagree without being disagreeable. Challenge the forecast, not the person.

climax.text: Superforecasting teams show that structured, evidence-based group processes can outperform even classified intelligence.

punchline.text: Challenge the forecast, not the person. Superforecasting teams beat.

quiz.question: What makes superforecasting teams successful?
options: Diverse perspectives, frequent updating, and a culture of constructive challenge
